meta.title: Linh Ung Pagoda (Lady Buddha), Da Nang: First-Time Visitor Guide
meta.description:
Planning to visit Linh Ung Pagoda (Lady Buddha) during your trip to Da Nang?
This first-time visitor guide covers everything you need to know before you go, including the best time to visit, how to get there, parking, entrance fees, how much time to allow, what to wear, important etiquette, monkey safety, and where to go next on Son Tra Peninsula.
Home to the iconic 67-meter Lady Buddha statue, Linh Ung Pagoda is one of the most famous landmarks in Da Nang and an essential stop for many visitors exploring Central Vietnam.
Whether you're planning your first trip to Da Nang or deciding how to include Son Tra Peninsula in your itinerary, this guide will help you make the most of your visit.
In this video:
• How to get to Linh Ung Pagoda
• Entrance fee & parking
• Best time to visit
• What to wear
• Temple etiquette
• Monkey safety tips
• How much time you need
• Where to go next on Son Tra Peninsula
